Does the existing suite actually have a test that hits the counter concurrently — multiple threads/tasks incrementing at once — or is it passing because nothing in it ever contended for the lock in the first place?

Race conditions are exactly the kind of bug a single-threaded test suite won't catch either way. If none of the existing tests spin up concurrent access, they'd have passed before the fix too — which means "tests pass" isn't evidence the race is actually gone, just that nothing regressed on the happy path.

Is there a new test that specifically drives concurrent increments and asserts the final count is correct? That's the one that would've failed on the old code and passes now — that's the real signal.
